title: Skillet Burgers with {v}
steps: Gently shape the {p} into patties about 3/4-inch thick, pressing a shallow dip in the middle. Season with salt and the {spice}.
Cook the patties in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat, 4 to 5 minutes a side, until {doneness}. Rest 2 minutes.
Slice the {v} to pile on top or serve alongside.
Build each burger with the {sauce}, the {v} and a patty. Serve on or with the {s}.
tip: Use lean ground meat or turkey, and pile on the vegetables instead of extra cheese.
